implementation_status: partial; confirmed Solar damage kills extend existing shared Radiant and Restoration

sources.support: 15-second extension limit and variable extension based on defeated combatant tier; not a current exhaustive tier catalogue.

current_policy.qualification: Confirmed kill actor currently owns fragment, actual damage fact has chorus:solar_damage, and at least one effect remains active at reaction processing. Solar origin tags alone do not qualify non-Solar damage.
current_policy.classification: Receipt-time EntityObservation supplies player and entity/type tags through event_entity_observed + read_event_entity. Death reactions may remove the corpse or mutate tags without changing classification. Player selects Guardian; otherwise exactly one distinct combatant_tier_1..4 is required. Duplicate same-tier tags count once; rank labels are not tier mappings.
current_policy.unknown: Missing/ambiguous classification emits empyrean_unclassified and does not invent an extension amount or alter timers. No retroactive repayment.
current_policy.extension: Independently extend existing Radiant and Restoration, no creation, no inferred cooldown. Cap remaining time at 15 even if currently longer, preserving source, tier and historic maximum. Exact expiry stays expired.
current_policy.solace: Use the quoted tier table unchanged; Solace is queried by application sources and Mercy. Solar D18 has no base-plus-Solace notation; Empyrean interaction remains a documented interpretation pending direct timing measurement.
current_policy.status_kills: Scorch periodic damage carries Solar damage identity and attributed killer; physical test validates it alongside actual Solar weapon kills.
current_policy.missing_entity_observation: Unknown, observed unavailable, absent tier or conflicting tiers reports the existing unclassified event. Never re-query the live corpse to manufacture historical classification.
